tool_calls.arguments: {"summary":"Putting ₱10,000 a month on the card and the rest into the emergency fund pays the card in 7 months (figure:debt1-W1:debt.payoff_months@debt:credit-card) and cuts its interest to ₱9,358.80 (figure:debt1-W1:debt.total_interest@debt:credit-card), while emergency savings reach the target faster (figure:debt1-W1:savings.months_to_target).
